question: A takes 24 days to finish a work and B takes 6 days for the same work. In how many days can A and B finish it together?

en.question: A takes 24 days to finish a work and B takes 6 days for the same work. In how many days can A and B finish it together?
en.explanation:
Take the LCM as total work.
\[
W=LCM(24,6)=24
\]
Find each worker's one-period efficiency.
\[
A=24/24=1,\quad B=24/6=4
\]
Divide total work by the combined efficiency.
\[
T=\frac{24}{1+4}=4.8
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=\frac{24\times 6}{24+6}=4.8
\]
Answer: 4 4/5 days

ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੰਮ ਕੱਢੋ।
\[
W_{cycle}=\sum r_i
\]
ਆਖਰੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਗਿਣੋ।
\[
W_{cycle}=6+6+4
\]
ਆਖਰੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਭਾਗ ਜੋੜੋ।
\[
T=13\frac{1}{3}
\]
ਸ਼ਾਰਟਕਟ / ਇਮਤਿਹਾਨੀ ਤਰੀਕਾ:
\[
T=cycles+final\ turn
\]
ਉੱਤਰ: 13 1/3 ਦਿਨ

question: Starting with A, two workers alternate. A completes 6 records and B completes 4 records on their respective turns. What is the completion time in days for 120 records?

en.question: Starting with A, two workers alternate. A completes 6 records and B completes 4 records on their respective turns. What is the completion time in days for 120 records?
en.explanation:
Find the work completed in one full cycle.
\[
W_{cycle}=\sum r_i
\]
Count full cycles before the last turn.
\[
W_{cycle}=6+4
\]
Add only the needed part of the final turn.
\[
T=24
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=cycles+final\ turn
\]
Answer: 24 days
